description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to displaying and managing pairing alert modals in a macOS application using AppKit. It includes window management, alert configuration, push notification handling, and request approval/rejection logic.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A custom NSWindow subclass that can become key or main window.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: Keeps track of the current active alert, request ID, and associated window during pairing alerts.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the currently active alert, optionally with a specified return code.

methods.name: requireAlertHostWindow
methods.description: Ensures there is an alert host window, creating a new one if necessary, and returns it.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Configures the provided NSAlert with standard style, buttons, and destructive action based on platform version.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Centers the alert sheet on the host window's screen and presents it modally.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Refreshes gateway connection, loads pending data, and consumes push notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Starts a background task for push notification handling if not already running.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and displays a pairing alert as a centered sheet, activating the app.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert and sets the current active alert and request ID.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert<Request>
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert with request-specific handling; calls onResponse upon user action.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears the current active alert and request ID, and hides the alert window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompt, cancels ongoing tasks, clears state, and closes windows.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Performs an approval action asynchronously, logs success or failure, and returns success status.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Performs a rejection action asynchronously, logs success or failure.
